$description: Canonical size source: control heights, icon boxes and indicator dimensions. Hand-edit this file only; dist/ is generated.

meta.source: Paper file 'F055 Desys 1' (01M5M3N461Y0VSS854R6G5S86K), plus a frequency tally across all 40 component previews and examples/dashboard-next.
meta.note: These were recorded as prose under radius.json's `controlHeights` from the first extraction and flagged as 'not yet tokens' in every README since. Building the Next.js dashboard made the cost concrete: every dimension in it was a literal, and that is the value most likely to drift when the same component is written again in Compose, in ERB and in Jinja2.
meta.evidence: Tally of width/height declarations across components/*/preview.html: 16px x124, 20px x65, 32px x40, 28px x24, 24px x18, 14px x12, 40px x11, 12px x11. 4, 6 and 8 appear as indicator dimensions (a status dot, a strength segment, a scrollspy pip, an accent swatch). 36, 48 and 80 appear once or twice each and are treated as incidental.
meta.naming: Named by pixel value, as radius and spacing are, because 4-6-8-12-14-16-20-24-28-32-40-64 is not a consistent ratio. The named roles below are the counterpart to radius's `pill`/`full` and typography's 15 named styles: they say what a value is FOR, so a button does not have to be remembered as 32.
meta.notTokenised: Layout widths - a 256px sidebar, a 384px panel, a 1200px content column - are deliberately absent. Those belong to a screen, not to the system; see README.md on why no containers or breakpoints were taken from the reference.

4.usage: Slider and progress track thickness, accent swatch width.

6.usage: Status dots. The smallest thing the system draws.

12.usage: The smallest icon: inside a badge, or beside 12px text.

14.usage: Chevrons and affordance icons that sit beside a 14px label without competing with it.

16.usage: The default icon, and the checkbox, radio and slider thumb. By far the most used dimension in the system.

20.usage: Badge and switch height; the largest icon.

24.usage: Icon button, close button, avatar inside a dense row.

32.usage: Default button, input, select, standard avatar. The system's default control height.

40.usage: Icon tile, table header row, large avatar.

64.usage: Textarea minimum height. The only value here above 40.

track.usage: Slider groove, progress bar, strength segment.

pip.usage: A scrollspy or carousel position marker.

icon-xs.usage: Icon inside a badge or beside 12px text.

icon-sm.usage: A chevron or affordance beside a 14px label.

icon.usage: The default icon. Use this unless there is a reason not to.

icon-lg.usage: An icon that carries a card or an empty state.

switch.usage: Switch height. Width is 32px - the one control that is not square or text-sized.

button.usage: Default button, input, select, textarea row.

tile.usage: Icon tile in an empty state, a spinner surround, a large avatar.
